title: Nexus CoreServiceStopResponse
description: Response for POST /v1/daemon/runtime/stop. The request is accepted only when expected_instance_id and expected_engine_epoch match the serving instance; a mismatch returns conflict and performs no stop. `stopped` reports a confirmed close; `stopping` reports that the owning service acknowledged the request and is draining.

status.description: `stopped`: cleanup is confirmed and the discovery record was removed by the owning service. `stopping`: the stop was accepted and the service is draining; poll runtime health for liveness.
